title: VTG Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Mother Grizzly Beast-Warrior/Effect MRL-090 Yugioh
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a rare Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card featuring the character Mother Grizzly, a Water-type Beast-Warrior creature with 1000 defense and 1400 attack power. It is from the Magic Ruler 1st Edition set by manufacturer Konami, with English language and a regular finish. The card has the card number MRL-090 and is considered a sought-after collectible for fans of the Yu-Gi-Oh! trading card game.
